purpose: Validate population risk curves, preserve individual rollout curves, and create the baseline system for a later small-patient perturbation analysis.
cohort_rule: Exact validated diabetes Cox modelable test cohort identified by person_id membership in cox_test_predictions.parquet.
primary_estimand: Cause-specific diabetes risk. Observed data use Kaplan-Meier 1-S(t), Cox uses cause-specific risk, and rollout treats generated death and token-cap end as censoring.
sensitivity_estimand: Generated competing-risk cumulative incidence. A generated death before diabetes remains a non-diabetes outcome in the denominator.

stage_boundary.included: Population curve comparison and saved individual baseline curves.
stage_boundary.deferred: Selection of individual patients, perturbation definitions, and high-rollout paired perturbation runs.
